snippet.title: Seven Lovers In The House // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2774830/Seven_Lovers_In_The_House

这是一款让你尽享「齐(七)人之福」的男性向恋爱互动影游。在这里你将与七位美女同住、同乐、同风雨，在这里爱与梦想绕梁不绝。
-  -  -  - - -
[Not an official english translation] - English language not supported for this game
This is a male-oriented romantic interactive video game that lets you enjoy the "blessing of seven women". Here, you will live, have fun, and weather storms with seven beautiful women, where love and dreams will linger.

Developed by 
Tofu Studio
